item.title: Nounsvitational 2025 results
item.description: <p><strong>Update</strong>: This story has been updated with final results.</p> <p>The Nounsvitational is back and this time, it's not taking place stateside but is in fact happening in Tokyo, Japan.</p> <p>Players who were invited or qualified are SR|Zain, LLD|Cody Schwab, Liquid|Hungrybox, SR|Moky, FLY|Jmook, RB|aMSa, Nouns|Aklo, SR|Joshman, Nouns|Nicki, Spiral|Krudo, lloD, Tempo|Axe, Soonsay, SDJ, Trif and Goodie.</p>

item.title: Daigo Umehara recounts the funny story of how he tried to mind game and entrap the person who allegedly stole his wallet
item.description: <p>BST|<a href='https://www.youtube.com/@DaigotheBeasTV'>Daigo Umehara</a> recently posted a whimsical video that had him telling "tales at the bar." At one point, Daigo talked about how he used to have an aversion to carrying a wallet with him.</p> <p>Rather than keeping his money safely contained within a wallet, he would instead keep cash in one pocket while carrying change in another. He apparently carried on like this until his mid twenties.</p>

item.title: Update: All 44 out of 48 confirmed Capcom Cup 12 qualified players
item.description: <p><strong>Update:</strong> This story has been updated with 44 of the 48 Capcom Cup qualified players.</p> <p>The third competitive season for <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/sf6/">Street Fighter 6</a> is already somehow close to coming to an end already, and it's about time to start looking forward to the big finals.</p> <p>Capcom Cup 12 is coming up next year, and most of the 48-player pool has been filled out with only a handful of spots remaining open.</p>

item.title: Street Fighter 6 is adding a VTuber to the game this month while players are still waiting for more Outfit 4 DLC support
item.description: <p>It's already been a few months since C. Viper released in <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/sf6/">Street Fighter 6</a>, and there appears to be some new content coming to the game this month though it's probably not what players were expecting — or maybe they are at this point.</p> <p>Capcom announced tonight that they're adding a popular VTuber to Street Fighter 6 later this month.</p>
